title: Targeting a systolic blood pressure of <130 mmHg is beneficial in adults with hypertension aged ≥75 years: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

evidence.reason: Inventory must identify exactly k distinct trials

answer.design_quote: We included RCTs that compared intensive BP lowering strategies (target SBP, <130 mmHg) with less intensive BP control (target SBP, ≥130 mmHg) in patients with hypertension aged ≥75 years.
answer.k_quote: Seven RCTs that met predefined eligibility criteria were included in the final meta-analysis.
